title: Restriction of the normalized components to a dense open
statement: Let k be a field, f:T→Spec k finite type, and a:X→T a dense open immersion [def-weil-field, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let c_i:C_i→T be integral closed subschemes indexed by Fin n whose distinct supports enumerate the irreducible components of T [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-irreducible-components]. There exist integral closed subschemes d_i:D_i→X, with distinct supports enumerating exactly the irreducible components of X, and open immersions j_i:D_i-normalization→C_i-normalization with dense nonempty image [def-sc-normalization]. Their normalization maps satisfy ν_Di followed by d_i followed by a equals j_i followed by ν_Ci followed by c_i.

source.place: Tag 0GK5, first paragraph, restriction from a projective completion; normalization as in Morphisms Tags 035K and 0CDV

proof.text: The given finite enumeration makes the set of components finite. For each component Z_i the complement of the union of all other components is nonempty open with closure Z_i (Mathlib closure_sUnion_irreducibleComponents_sdiff_singleton). Density of a makes this open meet its image, hence Z_i meets the dense open.

Take D_i=C_i×_T X. Its projection r_i to C_i is a nonempty open immersion, so D_i is integral. The projection d_i to X is closed, with support a^{-1}(Z_i). Mathlib preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents makes this a component. Closure of its image under a recovers Z_i, so the supports are distinct. For any component of X, take the closure of its image in T and extend it to a component Z_i; maximality in X forces it to equal a^{-1}(Z_i).

Apply the integral-open normalization comparison to each r_i. This gives open dense j_i, with nonempty source by integrality of D_i. Its normalization equation followed by c_i and the defining pullback equation give the displayed commutative square.

theorem exists_normalization_dense_open_components
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (T : Scheme.{u}) (f : T ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion a] (ha : DenseRange a)
    (n : ℕ) (C : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) [hC : ∀ i, IsIntegral (C i)]
    (c : ∀ i, C i ⟶ T) [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (c i)]
    (hi : Function.Injective (fun i ↦ Set.range (c i)))
    (hc : ∀ Z : Set T, Z ∈ irreducibleComponents T ↔ ∃ i, Set.range (c i) = Z) :
    ∃ (D : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (hD : ∀ i, IsIntegral (D i))
      (d : ∀ i, D i ⟶ X)
      (j : ∀ i, @Scheme.normalization (D i) (hD i) ⟶ (C i).normalization),
      (∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (d i) ∧ Set.range (d i) ∈ irreducibleComponents X) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i ↦ Set.range (d i)) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X, ∃ i, Set.range (d i) = Z) ∧
      ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i) ∧ DenseRange (j i) ∧
        Nonempty (@Scheme.normalization (D i) (hD i)) ∧
        @Scheme.fromNormalization (D i) (hD i) ≫ d i ≫ a =
          j i ≫ (C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i
